key_insight: Trotterized hybrid qubit-boson circuits simulate light-matter transport and entanglement dynamics in the Jaynes-Cummings-Hubbard model.
engineering_relevance: The approach provides a numerical benchmark for developing hybrid quantum simulations of coupled cavities and more complex light-matter systems.
method: Build Trotterized circuits in Bosonic Qiskit with a matrix product state backend.
Simulate single-polariton transport and two-excitation dynamics under a hard-core photon constraint.
Study bipartite entanglement entropy versus inter-cavity photon-hopping strength.
evidence_signal: Single-polariton site occupations are benchmarked against exact diagonalization; the abstract reports no quantitative error metrics.
watch_item: The hard-core photon constraint restricts the two-excitation study, so its results should not be generalized to unrestricted photon occupancy.
paper_title: Trotterized hybrid qubit-boson simulation of the Jaynes-Cummings-Hubbard model
